aletu.title: Adaptive learning for educational transform of Uganda

valueProposition.solution: ALETU is a personalized, adaptive educational platform that leverages AI-driven learning paths, mastery learning principles, and cognitive assessments to transform educational outcomes

keyBenefits.students: Receive engaging, tailored education that improves outcomes
keyBenefits.teachers: Save time on administrative tasks and focus on meaningful mentorship
keyBenefits.schools: Reduce dropout rates and improve overall academic performance

differentiators: Seamless integration of cross-cutting issues like environmental awareness and ethics
AI-generated lesson plans and assessments aligned with the national curriculum
